entries.what: Labor Day: Marcus works his Sunday-night shift into Monday morning at Ridgeline RF-4, picking totes on the general pick floor at holiday time-and-a-half. Carla walks the floor more than usual.
entries.outcome: Finished the shift with a bigger check coming.

entries.what: Rides the bike home from Ridgeline past families setting up picnics at Delgado Park, eats eggs and rice, and sleeps 8 a.m. to 1 p.m. while the college is closed.
entries.outcome: Full sleep, no class today.

entries.what: Evening at the Marisol Gardens unit with Arjun, who talks about internship applications; Marcus pays his rent share portal reminder and heads out to the 10 p.m. shift.
entries.outcome: Rent share paid via the portal.

entries.what: After the night shift Marcus sleeps 8 a.m. to 1 p.m., then skips the gym and goes over Fatima's shared Ex Phys notes before the week's classes.
entries.outcome: Caught up on Monday's missed lecture notes.

entries.what: At Ridgeline, Noemi's help desk swaps a dead scanner for him, and new tech Bao Tran is shadowing her on his first day.
entries.outcome: Got a working scanner and kept rate.

entries.what: Reads the breakroom board at 9:40 p.m. for his dock assignment, then clocks in at 10 with Trevor beside him on the floor.
entries.outcome: Assigned the general pick floor again.

entries.what: Back from the night shift, sleeps until 1, then takes the Tule Line to Bayshore for the 2 p.m. section, nodding off in Biomechanics.
entries.outcome: Fatima shares her notes after class.

entries.what: Quick call with his mom Denise on the train home about her week at the drugstore; she says she is fine.
entries.outcome: Marcus hung up unsure she is telling him everything.

entries.what: Heads to Ridgeline for the night shift, listening to old-school West Coast rap in one earbud while picking.
entries.outcome: Hit rate without trouble.

entries.what: Sleeps after shift, then goes to the 2 p.m. Thursday section at Bayshore and the Stats 120 lecture.
entries.outcome: Stats material went over his head; wrote down questions.

entries.what: Quick dinner of leftover rice and chicken at home; Arjun suggests he go to bed earlier and Marcus brushes it off.
entries.outcome: Said he would handle it himself.

entries.what: Thursday night shift at Ridgeline; Trevor complains about rate again while Marcus keeps his phone on a power bank-less battery that dies before 4 a.m.
entries.outcome: Phone dead by 4 a.m. again.

entries.what: Payday Friday: after shift Marcus gets a Taquería Colima burrito on Calle Ortega, then sleeps. Ridgeline pays biweekly on Fridays.
entries.outcome: Paycheck landed; burrito treat.

entries.what: Lifts at Iron Flats Fitness in the early evening with Mike's 5/3/1 program, working toward his deadlift goal.
entries.outcome: Solid session, kept his deadlift at 375.

entries.what: Stays home during the Egrets home opener that draws half the town to the stadium, and texts Jade about her day off before his shift.
entries.outcome: Jade was a bit short with him about his schedule.

entries.what: Finishes the night shift; Carla hands out conchas to the crew as she does on Saturdays.
entries.outcome: Free concha, shift ended on time.

entries.what: Sleeps until early afternoon, then a lift at Iron Flats Fitness and groceries at Ruiz Family Market.
entries.outcome: Stocked up for the next day's prep.

entries.what: Saturday evening date with Jade at Phở Bến Thành, trying to make up for last night's tension.
entries.outcome: Good night; Jade laughed at his jokes.

entries.what: Messages the assistant right after his shift at 7 a.m. asking for a cheap high-protein meal prep list for the week, since he can't keep eating random meals.
entries.outcome: Got a chicken-and-rice prep list.

entries.what: Sleeps, then cooks his first Sunday chicken-and-rice batch into five containers in the Marisol Gardens kitchen.
entries.outcome: Five containers stacked in the fridge.

entries.what: Quiet evening with Arjun before heading out to a Sunday-night shift at Ridgeline.
entries.outcome: Week starts with food ready.
